_note: Campaign-level aggregate — one record per war, updated at station 6 as each year closes. The analytics substrate over the annals (the cycles.json analogue from AgenticProcess research practice). Derived, not authoritative: the annals win on any disagreement and this file is regenerated from them. The ten-year test of the rite (docs/CAMPAIGN.md § The refinement contract) is read off this file.

_schema.doctrine_amendments: list of {year, rule} the war earned; empty means precedent stood
_schema.phrase_bank: tally object {attested_adapted, invented} of candidates proposed
_schema.conformance_fails: list of {year, checks: [R#]} — empty means the rite ran clean (docs/CAMPAIGN.md § Rite conformance)
_schema.calibration_notes: count of observations proposed toward BL-271 (Era -1 sim), BL-272 (mil-sim) constants, BL-274 (era-keyed rosters)
